title: Disney Animated Films
description: Years, directors, voice cast across the Walt Disney Animation canon.

questions.prompt: What year was The Lion King originally released?
questions.explanation: The Lion King was the highest-grossing film of 1994 and the top traditionally animated film ever; Hans Zimmer won an Oscar for the score.

questions.prompt: What year was Beauty and the Beast released?
questions.explanation: Beauty and the Beast was the first animated film ever nominated for the Best Picture Oscar; the awards changed rules for it the next year.

questions.prompt: What year was Mulan released?
questions.explanation: Mulan released between Hercules (1997) and Tarzan (1999); it was the first Disney animated feature based on a Chinese legend.

questions.prompt: What year was Tangled released?
questions.explanation: Tangled was Disney's 50th animated feature and at the time the most expensive animated film ever made, costing around $260 million.

questions.prompt: What year was Zootopia released?
questions.explanation: Zootopia won the 2017 Oscar for Best Animated Feature, beating Moana, which released the same year.

questions.prompt: What year was Encanto released?
questions.explanation: Encanto blew up on TikTok in early 2022; 'We Don't Talk About Bruno' became the first Disney song to top the Billboard Hot 100 since 1993.

questions.prompt: What is Stitch's experiment number in Lilo & Stitch?
questions.explanation: Experiment 626 is the number Jumba assigned Stitch; the date 6/26 is now informally celebrated as 'Stitch Day' by fans.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Lilo's older sister in Lilo & Stitch?
questions.explanation: Nani is Lilo's struggling young legal guardian after their parents died; her name means 'beautiful' in Hawaiian.

questions.prompt: In Encanto, what is the family surname?
questions.explanation: The Madrigals live in a magical 'casita' in the Colombian mountains; each family member except Mirabel has a magical gift.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the lost city in Atlantis: The Lost Empire?
questions.explanation: Atlantis: The Lost Empire (2001) had a language created by Marc Okrand, the linguist who invented Klingon for Star Trek.

questions.prompt: In Big Hero 6, what is the inflatable healthcare robot's name?
questions.explanation: Baymax is voiced by Scott Adsit; his rounded design was inspired by real soft robotics research at Carnegie Mellon University.

questions.prompt: What city is Big Hero 6 set in?
questions.explanation: San Fransokyo is a fictional mashup of San Francisco and Tokyo; the bridge has torii-style gates and the buildings blend both skylines.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Mulan's singing voice in the 1998 film?
questions.explanation: Lea Salonga also provided the singing voice for Jasmine in Aladdin (1992); Ming-Na Wen handled Mulan's speaking voice.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Hercules in the 1997 Disney film?
questions.explanation: Tate Donovan voiced the speaking Hercules; Roger Bart sang the songs, and teen Hercules was voiced by a young Joshua Keaton.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Quasimodo in The Hunchback of Notre Dame?
questions.explanation: Tom Hulce also played Mozart in Amadeus (1984); The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996) is one of Disney's darkest animated features.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Tarzan in the 1999 Disney film?
questions.explanation: Tony Goldwyn later became famous as President Fitzgerald Grant on Scandal; Phil Collins wrote and performed the Oscar-winning soundtrack.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Rapunzel in Tangled?
questions.explanation: Mandy Moore had already had a pop career before voicing Rapunzel; she sang the Oscar-nominated 'I See the Light' with co-star Zachary Levi.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Judy Hopps in Zootopia?
questions.explanation: Ginnifer Goodwin played Snow White on Once Upon a Time before voicing Judy, Zootopia's first bunny police officer.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Nick Wilde in Zootopia?
questions.explanation: Jason Bateman replaced Jason Sudeikis, who was originally attached; Nick is a fast-talking fox conman who becomes Judy's partner.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the dog in Bolt who thinks he has superpowers?
questions.explanation: Bolt is a white American shepherd voiced by John Travolta; the film was a turning point that led to Disney's late-2000s revival.

questions.prompt: In Wreck-It Ralph, what is the name of the racing game Vanellope lives in?
questions.explanation: Sugar Rush is a candy-themed kart racer parody; the arcade hub Game Central Station was inspired by New York's Grand Central Terminal.

questions.prompt: In Brother Bear, what is the name of the human protagonist who transforms into a bear?
questions.explanation: Kenai is voiced by Joaquin Phoenix in Brother Bear (2003); the film was nominated for the Best Animated Feature Oscar.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the protagonist in Treasure Planet?
questions.explanation: Treasure Planet (2002) is a sci-fi retelling of Treasure Island; it famously bombed at the box office despite a passionate cult following.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the protagonist's pet rooster in Moana?
questions.explanation: Heihei was nearly cut from the film; directors Ron Clements and John Musker fought to keep him after Alan Tudyk improvised the squawks.

questions.prompt: In Raya and the Last Dragon, what is the name of the last dragon?
questions.explanation: Sisu is voiced by Awkwafina; the film draws from Southeast Asian cultures and was Disney's first to feature a Southeast Asian princess.
